title: Russia Partially Lifts Diesel Export Ban, Clears 500,000 Tons
detail: Russia's government partially lifted its diesel export ban (in force since July 2026) a day after the Trump-Putin deal, allowing 500,000 tons to be sold abroad with immediate effect. Deputy PM Alexander Novak said domestic consumers would not be affected and domestic diesel output is sufficient. Analysts questioned whether refineries and sanctioned tankers can deliver meaningful volumes.
